notes.title: Major Demo Update for Tiny Teams Festival
notes.content:
The 2025 Tiny Teams festival, hosted by Yogscast Games, has just started, and will run until August 14th! With it comes a huge update to the Moonsigil Atlas demo, and some exclusive content you might see on Twitch streams in the next week.


What's in the demo update?
Here's some of the new content in the demo you can play now:

Eclipse levels for additional difficulty modifiers once you've beaten the demo

New encounters, including Astral Card Packs and new forms of infusing

Improved visuals for the player character and encounters

Even more, including starting boons, character mastery, run history, Astral Dust, new cards, and a lot of small quality-of-life improvements


Catch us on the Yogscast stream
Want to see even more of the game, or chat with the developers? Our game will be featured on the Yogscast Twitch stream during the festival:

Date: Monday, August 11, during the 5-8pm BST time slot (12-3pm EDT)

Twitch:  http://twitch.tv/yogscast

Youtube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@yogscast"][/dynamiclink]

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025

Yogscast will be streaming exclusive content from the full game, so keep an eye out for the third playable character Tark'thul and additional enemies, bosses, and encounters in Act 2. We will be in Twitch chat and happy to talk about the game!


More Tiny Teams
Tiny Teams is a festival all about games made by teams smaller than 5 people, or even individual developers. In the past, it's featured games like Stardew Valley, Balatro, Phasmophobia, Vampire Survivors, and many others!  Check out the Tiny Teams store page to play more demos from hidden indie gems, or catch discounts on established indie titles until August 14th! 


Thanks for your support!

Jeremy and Daniel
Snake Tower Games

notes.title: Upcoming: Tiny Teams Festival and Massive Demo Update
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce that Moonsigil Atlas will be featured in the Tiny Teams festival next week, hosted by Yogscast Games! There will also be a huge update to the public demo on August 7, the first day of the festival.


Here's what you can expect in the August 7th update:

Eclipse levels for additional difficulty modifiers once you've beaten the demo

New encounters, including Astral Card Packs and new forms of infusing

Improved visuals for the player character and encounters

Even more, including starting boons, character mastery, run history, Astral Dust, new cards, and a lot of small quality-of-life improvements

Additionally, keep an eye out for anyone streaming Moonsigil Atlas during Tiny Teams - you might catch some gameplay of the new playable character, Tark'thul, and additional content that won't be available in the demo!

If you're interested in participating in the closed playtest, where we make weekly updates to the game based on your feedback, please join our Discord server. Thanks so much to all the playtesters who have already contributed.

notes.title: The Demo Has Released!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that the Moonsigil Atlas demo is out now! This version of the game has over 100 cards, two playable characters, and a plethora of enemies to overcome, including the first of the three astral titans.

If you want to know more about what will and won't be in the demo version of the game, check out our previous announcement.

How to Support Us
If you want to help us make the demo launch as successful as possible, here's what you can do!

🕹️ Play the demo
Download the demo today, and try a run or two.
👍 Give the demo a review
Your feedback helps us make the game better, and it also improves the game's visibility on Steam.
💬 Share the demo
Consider sharing the demo with a friend, content creator, or group who may be interested.

Feedback and Community
If you are looking for a place to discuss strategy, suggest a change, or report a bug, there is an official Discord server with almost 200 members. We will be hosting a demo launch stream via Discord later today where we will preview the third character!

Thank you!
If you have any problems, questions, or comments, please reach out to us. We're happy to help and excited to get the full game out to you as soon as possible!

Jeremy and Daniel
Snake Tower Games

notes.title: Demo Releases May 14th
notes.content:
On May 14th, you'll be able to play the free demo for Moonsigil Atlas. We've been working toward a public demo for months now, and are excited to bring an early version of the game into your hands soon.

How to Support Us
If you would like to help us make the demo launch as successful as possible, here's what you can do on May 14th:

Play the demo 
Download the demo on the day it releases, and try a run or two.
Give the demo a review 
Steam hides games with fewer than ten reviews, so we're hoping to pass that threshold as soon as possible with your help.
Share the demo 
Consider sharing the demo with with a friend, content creator, or group who may be interested.

Discord and Demo Launch Stream

We'll be streaming gameplay of the demo and a sneak peak of the third playable character to the Moonsigil Atlas Discord server on May 14th. If you're interested in viewing, you can join the Discord with the following link: https://discord.gg/FCWXyRyGUW

From the Discord server, you can also:
- Discuss game strategy with the developers and other players
- Contribute to community translation
- Submit gameplay suggestions and bug reports, and receive credit in the game's patch notes
- Join the closed playtest, which will continue to receive new content updates beyond what is in the demo

Thank you for supporting us, and we look forward to sharing the demo with you soon.

Jeremy and Daniel
Snake Tower Games

notes.title: The Demo Page Is Live!
notes.content:
The "coming soon" page for the Moonsigil Atlas Demo just went live! You can't play the demo quite yet, but we're excited to share more details with you.

What's in the Demo?

Two playable characters (three characters in the full game)
One act of content, ending in a boss fight (three acts in the full game)
Many enemies, encounters, and upgrades (even more in the full game)
Support for Windows, Mac, and Linux - with Steam Cloud integration to save your progress (even across platforms)

There are a few features planned for the full game that will not be included in the demo, or will be patched in after the initial demo launch. These include:

Unlockable difficulty or "ascension" levels
Localization to non-English languages
Controller support

Thanks, Playtesters!
Thanks to everyone who has contributed to the ongoing closed playtest! Your feedback has been extremely valuable as we prepare for the public demo and eventual release of Moonsigil Atlas.

If you are not involved in the playtest but are interested in signing up, you can do so from the official Moonsigil Atlas Discord server.

Thanks for your support!

Jeremy and Daniel
Snake Tower Games

notes.title: Moonsigil Atlas Playtest Update - Version 0.0.4
notes.content:
We've just made the first update to the Moonsigil Atlas playtest. This update adds new map encounters, two new card keywords, and several new cards. The new version also includes bug fixes, balance changes, and quality-of-life improvements.

We'll be aiming to release playtest updates every Friday. The updates will vary in size (some features take more than a week to develop) but at minimum, we'll be getting out quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes every week.

If you want to play the game as soon as possible, we're giving priority access to playtesters who sign up through our Discord server. You can also use Discord to directly submit bug reports, request features, and join discussions about strategy. Otherwise, we'll be rolling out access to Steam sign-ups over time as we improve the game.

Thanks,
Daniel and Jeremy

Change Log - Playtest Version 0.0.4

Features:

 New type of map encounter added -> Upgrading cards with keywords
 Added "Bolster" card attribute
 Added "Prepared" card keyword
 Added "Prepared" to Expose weakness and Paraselene
 Barbed Buckler has been reworked to use "Bolster"
 Added new SFX
 Added new card: Cultivate
 Added new card: Safeguard
 Added new card: Keystone

Balance:

 Reduce the cost of Refresh
 Make Enervate a bit bigger and apply more Exposed per turn
 Changed the shape of the "Shackle" hostile sigils placed in an Elite fight
 Slightly reduced Feldryn's max health
 Slightly increased healing from the heal map encounter
 Improved the quality of cards given in an Astral Gem card reward

Quality of Life:

 Add a warning when you try to change the shape of a card that transforms
 Add a version number to the settings menu
 Made version number significantly more human-readable
 "Save and Quit" button now quits to the main menu

Bugfixes:

 Sage's Mettle applies Shield to the right region when triggered with Korlim's Verse
 Refresh works as expected in combination with Stargaze
 Refresh works as expected in combination with Duplicate
 Cards in browsers should no longer disappear after doing multiple runs
 "Bolt" should now draw properly in the tooltip for "Thunderbolt" after doing multiple runs
 Focus no longer increases damage dealt directly to the player
 Adjacency effects are now removed when cards transform (e.g. Debris)
 "Move On" options in map encounters are now properly displaying 
 Rune impact SFX now plays
 Fixed audio bug where multiple sigil removal SFX could play after ending combat
 Fixed audio bug where negative status effects were playing the positive status effect SFX
 Fixed audio bug where status effect SFX could be played multiple times
 Fixed bug where tooltiped card animations can fail
 Wishlist button now opens Steam overlay instead of the default web browser
 Fixed run timer calculating time incorrectly (not currently visible to players)
 Fixed issue with boss sigil placement logic (minor balance implications)
 Fixed rare null reference exception on status effect animator
 Fixed rare null reference exception on card keyword animator

notes.title: Now Accepting Playtest Sign-Ups!
notes.content:
We're currently accepting playtest sign-ups for Moonsigil Atlas!

About the playtest

This will be an early build of the game, and will not include all of the final characters, cards, and enemies.
The playtest build will be distributed through Steam Playtest. It will show up in your library like all of your other Steam games, and you can play it whenever you'd like during the duration of the playtest.
We'll automatically collect some gameplay information, like which cards you buy. This will help us tune the balance and make the game as good as possible for release.

Playtest timelines

We will start with a very small number of playtesters the week of January 27, 2025. Over time, we will include more testers.
The playtest will receive frequent updates as we add features and fix bugs. Your playtest build will automatically update through Steam.


If you're interested in signing up, click the "Request Access" button on the Moonsigil Atlas store page.

We're excited to get the game in your hands!

Thanks,
Jeremy and Daniel
Snake Tower Games
